description: TCP handles an illegal MSS option length in a SYN,ACK without crashing (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.5 p85). Iterations: ilen=0 and ilen=5
approach:
[Objective]
Mirror of MSS_OPTIONS_01 from the active-OPEN side: DUT in SYN-SENT receives a SYN,ACK with malformed MSS — must complete handshake or refuse, not crash.

[Scenario — chronological]
Two iterations: DUT active OPEN; tester replies SYN,ACK with MSS length 0 / length 5; DUT must ack to complete handshake (rejecting the bad option silently).

[Pass condition]
DUT acks SYN,ACK in both phases.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_phase<n> — no DUT ACK to phase n's malformed-MSS SYN,ACK

verdicts.Pass: DUT survived illegal MSS in SYN,ACK — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout_phase1: No DUT ACK to SYN,ACK with ilen=0 MSS
verdicts.Fail_timeout_phase2: No DUT ACK to SYN,ACK with ilen=5 MSS
